SHIPPED: Two UX fixes committed at 29614c0 and pushed to GitHub

BUG 1 — Answer position bias:
SYMPTOM: 66% of correct answers at position 2 (51/77 exercises). Position 4 was NEVER correct. User could get 2/3 right by always tapping position 2.
FIX: SeededRandomNumberGenerator keyed to exercise.id — choices shuffle per exercise ID, stable within session, different from source order each session
FILES: ClassifyExerciseView.swift, FillTemplateExerciseView.swift, MultiSelectExerciseView.swift, SeededRandomNumberGenerator.swift (new)

BUG 2 — Keyboard persists between exercises:
SYMPTOM: After text-input exercise, keyboard stays visible on next tap-based exercise
FIX: ExerciseSessionView dismisses keyboard on .onChange(of: currentIndex) AND when evaluating/feedback state activates
FILES: ExerciseSessionView.swift

ONBOARDING: Added .accessibilityIdentifier("OnboardingPage_(page.id)") for Maestro testability
FILE: OnboardingView.swift
